### Knowing Your Limitations
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/knowing-your-limitations-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-14.html
Passage: Mark 4:26-28
Points:
- Believers are responsible for sharing God's Word, but cannot produce spiritual life on their own.
- The power to transform human hearts belongs entirely to God, working in hidden and mysterious ways.
- Recognizing personal limits brings humility and relieves the pressure of controlling people's spiritual responses.
- Acknowledging human inability is never an excuse for passivity; Christians must still faithfully plant and harvest.

### Slow and Steady Growth
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/slow-and-steady-growth
Passage: Mark 4:26-29
Points:
- God's kingdom advances through ordinary, unspectacular means rather than flashy methods.
- The growth of the kingdom is slow and steady, unfolding through the hidden work of God alone.
- Believers must show patience, faithfully fulfilling their daily callings while trusting the Lord for results.
- Relying on manipulative or superficial tactics undermines the gospel and fails to produce lasting fruit.
